lines.B01: Make your bed electrically adjustable – in just a few minutes.
lines.B02: CosyLift arrives in one compact parcel and weighs just 9 kilograms.
lines.B03: Inside: the CosyLift, a remote, a power supply and an anti-slip mat.
lines.B04: Step one: plug in the remote.
lines.B05: Step two: lift the mattress and slide CosyLift underneath – your slatted frame stays where it is.
lines.B06: Step three: lay the mattress back and plug in the power supply. Done.
lines.B08: …and it raises you smoothly, up to 59 degrees.
lines.B09: It works just the same on a box spring bed.
lines.B10: CosyLift. Make more of your bed.
